title: Remove the inert scaffold controls: actions-bar and batteries-filters
goal: No control in the app does nothing: the footer Scan QR and camera buttons and the header battery-filter checkboxes are gone
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat on the hidden-code sweep (coordinator docs/reviews/2026-11-26-hidden-code.md): "1 remove".

src/app/shared/UI/actions-bar/ (Scan QR and camera buttons, no handler) and src/app/shared/UI/batteries-filters/ (Charged, Stored, Discharged and Hide Dismissed checkboxes, no binding), both added in commit 6b75548, are deleted with their templates, state and any tests; footer.ts/footer.html and header.ts/header.html no longer import or render them
No other component, route or doc references them: docs/agents/coverage.md and the F-008-T05 bricks inventory drop their rows; no dead styles, tokens or exports remain (check:conventions passes)
If a later feature needs QR scanning or battery filters it gets its own record: nothing is kept as a placeholder
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption
A control that turns out to have a handler or a record goes to the owner, not removed silently

effort.basis: Two empty-class components (14 and 78 template lines), two parent edits and one coverage row. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed. Not a measurement.
